prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not say my full name on the recording, if that's okay. Just know I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision occurred?

A: It was at a four-way intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading east.

Q: And what happened as you entered the intersection?

A: A pickup coming from the north ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't even see him until he was on top of me. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags did deploy on my side, though, and the seatbelt locked hard across my chest.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?

A: Not right away. I was sore, but I figured it was adrenaline. By that evening my lower back was stiff and aching, and it's gotten worse with sitting or bending.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider for your back?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a lumbar strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy. I'm still going to sessions.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?

A: Only that I was following the traffic signal and did nothing to cause the crash. I'm willing to provide the medical records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
